pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeat Captain Cornelia and Sea Viper. In the Sunken City use an Abyssal Sacrifice at the Altar of Abyss; prepare underwater breathing. This is world history, not proof of personal participation. Dedicated servers retain hosted encounter admission; singleplayer uses native combat. The encounter

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Abyssal Sacrifice uses Athame, coral, Nautilus Shell, Heart of the Sea and diamond/emerald/iron/amethyst/gold blocks; a second recipe swaps the coral variant. Check the effective recipe.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: In the Sunken City the altar consumes its offering when Leviathan successfully spawns; empty right-click is not summoning.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Abyss Eye locates Sunken City. A native locator does not replace canonical JEM admission. Check its current acquisition recipe.
